title: GENERAL MANAGER - OPERATIONS
description:

* **Develop and implement effective sales and marketing strategies to achieve organizational targets.**
* **Lead, manage, guide, and motivate a team of 7–10 Sales Executives.**

* **Strong experience in the Building Materials / Construction Industry.**

* **Strong communication and interpersonal skills.**
* **Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.**

title: Operations Manager
description:
Job Description – Operations Manager (Reviewer)

**Job Title:** Operations Manager (Reviewer)  
**Department:** Operations  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** kochi  
**Reporting To:** Management / Operations Head

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented **Operations Manager (Reviewer)** to oversee operational activities, review team performance, ensure process compliance, and maintain the quality and accuracy of daily operations. The ideal candidate should have strong leadership, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities

* Review and monitor daily operational activities and team performance.
* Ensure that employees follow company processes, SOPs, and operational guidelines.
* Review reports, documents, CRM activities, and work outputs for accuracy and completeness.
* Track team KPIs, targets, productivity, and performance.
* Identify operational gaps and coordinate with team members to resolve issues.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
* Monitor workflow and ensure tasks are completed within defined timelines.
* Verify data, reports, customer records, and other operational documentation.
* Coordinate with different departments to ensure smooth workflow.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports for management.
* Maintain proper documentation and records of operational activities.
* Identify process inefficiencies and recommend improvements.
* Support the implementation and improvement of SOPs and internal processes.
* Ensure timely follow-up on pending tasks and action items.
* Handle escalations and operational issues when required.
* Assist management in implementing new processes, policies, and initiatives.
* Maintain confidentiality of company and employee information.

Reviewer-Specific Responsibilities

* Review team members' work before final submission or approval.
* Check the quality, accuracy, and completeness of assigned work.
* Identify errors and communicate corrections to the concerned employees.
* Maintain a record of recurring errors and recommend corrective actions.
* Conduct periodic quality audits.
* Ensure compliance with approved formats, SOPs, and company standards.
* Provide feedback and coaching to improve work quality.

Required Skills

* Strong leadership and team-management skills.
* Good analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, Google Workspace, and CRM systems.
* Ability to prepare and analyze reports.
* Good time-management and organizational skills.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Strong decision-making and coordination skills.

Qualification & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, HR, or a related field.
* **4–7 years of experience** in operations, administration, team supervision, quality review, or a related role.
* Experience in reviewing reports, monitoring KPIs, and managing operational workflows will be an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Operational task completion rate
* Team productivity and target achievement
* Work accuracy and quality
* Error rate and correction rate
* SOP/process compliance
* Timely report submission
* Issue resolution time
* Team performance improvement
* Customer/service quality
* Overall operational efficiency

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement

Work Location: In person
